reason: Unclaimed source-backed organizers must not accidentally inherit Catch booking, payment, waitlist, host-contact, or premature review affordances from scattered client conditionals. One shared capability projection makes the policy explicit across organizers, compatibility clubs, external events, Flutter, and the public website.

item.bookable: whether a Catch booking path may be rendered
item.payable: whether a Catch payment path may be rendered
item.waitlistable: whether a Catch waitlist path may be rendered
item.hostContactable: whether direct host contact may be rendered
item.claimable: whether the organizer can enter the ownership-claim flow
item.reviewable: never or after_event_end for the supported unclaimed-supply policy

phases.description: Add the shared capability schema to canonical organizers, compatibility clubs, external events, and the public website projection.
Organizer creation, candidate draft creation, and organizer/club claim decisions derive and persist the shared projection.
Flutter and the public website consume the shared projection and fail closed when it is absent or invalid.
The dry-run-first repair derived capabilities from existing ownership and claim authority without inventing event provenance.
External-event publication snapshots the organizer ceiling, requires explicit blocker resolutions, and emits immutable dry-run/apply/takedown receipts.

A dedicated app-side submission flow for reviews of passed external events on unclaimed organizers remains an app-team dependency. This migration exposes eligibility but does not invent the submission authority.

environmentEvidence.dev: Contract and focused tests verified locally on 2026-07-27; no environment mutation was required.
environmentEvidence.staging: Not mutated; production was the legacy corpus requiring repair.
environmentEvidence.prod: 2026-07-27: dry run scanned 44 organizers, 42 clubs, and 0 external events with 86 repairs and 0 invalid records; apply repaired all 86; post-apply dry run reported 86 current, 0 repairs, and 0 invalid records.

rulesAndIndexes.firestoreRules: Direct organizer, club, and external-event writes remain denied; callable validation owns this migration.
rulesAndIndexes.firestoreIndexes: No new query index is required because capabilities are rendering and write-authority inputs rather than collection filters.
